card.name: Failure to respond to other therapies
card.fires_on: The word "to" after "respond" or "unresponsive" when the text says a patient did not respond to other drugs. It also fires on a few link words in treatment-failure or overdose-treatment lists.

modes.label: Not responding to other drugs
modes.description: "to" right after "respond" or "unresponsive" in phrases about patients who fail other treatments.
modes.example: may be used with caution in patients with bronchospastic disease who do not respond<< to>> or cannot tolerate other antihypert

modes.label: Persisting despite treatment
modes.description: A linking word where a problem continues despite therapy, or a comma in a list of overdose measures.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words about trying other treatments, such as trials, retry and experiments.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a label where a patient has not responded to other treatments.
